stimulus_text: A national guidance document requires schools to maintain lockdown procedures.
The school board approved a local lockdown policy last term.
Two trained marshals and a working PA system are available during school hours.
Observers timed a drill: all classes reached secure rooms in under four minutes.
After a real incident, after-action review found delayed lockdown initiation.
The school has a written PEEP template on file.
A named buddy is rostered and present for Student X during the school day.
The calendar lists two lockdown drills for the year.
Video of yesterday's drill shows students misunderstanding the PA message.
The drill went smoothly, so the school claims the plan would work in a real attack.
Accessible exit signage is installed throughout the building.
A comprehension check during drill showed three students could not interpret the signs under noise.
A memorandum of understanding with local police is signed.
During a tabletop, police liaison and school leads completed the escalation decision tree in 8 minutes.
National doctrine says plans should be inclusive.
Staff report that inclusive adaptations are rarely staffed on drill day.
Incident statistics show fewer injuries after a new plan — attributed causally without design.
The centre downloaded the national template but never completed local fields.
